cohort: 12064 parturients who gave birth in Xingtai People's Hospital from January 2015 to December 2019
finding: The cesarean section rate in Xingtai People's Hospital showed a decreasing trend from 2015 to 2019, and using the Robson Ten Group Classification System improved the comparability of monitoring data.
